part_a_retained_status.disclosure: latency gate not met (2,104 ms vs 1,500 ms gate; 4.6x faster than 30B)

presealed_holdout_digests.prior_baseline_exposure_note: Always_Abstain_Baseline, Base_Qwen2.5_7B, and SFT_Qwen2.5_7B (50.00% on EVAL_VIRGIN_V2, 61.67% on EVAL_WAVE6_LOOK2) were scored in R0 Stage 1 prior to Protocol v2; zero GRPO checkpoints have ever been evaluated on EVAL_VIRGIN_V2.

seed_42_dev_only_4point_history.step_80_and_step_120_note: Intermediate DEV checkpoints on the 4-point R0 schedule were observed live on Spark #2 showing progressive over-abstention drift; exact per-step JSON scalars were not persisted because seed_42 aborted prior to checkpoint write.

step_160_final.observation: Over-abstention collapse driven structurally by FALSE_ABSTAIN_REWARD (-0.55) > WRONG_DETERMINATE_REWARD (-1.00) under group-std advantage normalization plus small prompt-group batch (2/step) and aggressive LR/KL.

abort_location_and_cause.root_cause: LoRA adapter weights saved in bf16 were loaded with autocast_adapter_dtype=False onto an fp32 base without casting peft_fp32.float(), causing bf16-vs-fp32 rounding difference (0.002645 >= 1e-4) in _verify_fp32_merge_and_unload_parity before line 2640 could execute.

protocol_v2_bundled_specification.attribution_disclaimer: Protocol v2 ships 7 bundled stability, reward, parity, and holdout-hygiene fixes simultaneously; no single knob is credited causally with curing collapse.

parity_and_resume_hardening.stage1_sft_reuse_policy: Reuse existing merged_sft_dir weights ONLY if double-reload parity < 1e-4 and shift vs base > 1e-4; recompute Stage-1 DEV-only checkpoint without touching EVAL_VIRGIN_V2.

out_of_loop_holdout_lock.freeze_verification_rule: Verify byte-for-byte SHA-256 of merged_sft_dir, all final_step and eligible best_dev adapters, script, and d9b_amendment_v1.json immediately before Stage 3 one-shot scoring; refuse to score on any mismatch.

primary_endpoint.aggregation: 3-seed mean across (137, 2026, 31415) with 2-seed (137, 2026) mean reported alongside
primary_endpoint.statistical_test: paired_bootstrap_wave6 (10000 resamples, two-sided p-value) + holm_bonferroni_stepdown across {vs SFT_7B, vs Base_7B, vs Bare_Nemotron_30B} at alpha=0.05

secondary_endpoint.selection_rule: Evaluate DEV every 10 steps (10..60) alongside step=0 SFT baseline. A step>0 checkpoint is eligible ONLY if dev_determinate_exact_match >= sft_dev_det_em - 0.03. Pick highest eligible dev_exact_match (tie-break dev_mean_total_reward) strictly outperforming step=0 SFT; if no step>0 is eligible, record best_dev_status='none_eligible_fell_back_to_step0_sft' and fell_back_to_step0_sft=true using merged_sft_dir (never copy final_step into best_dev_dir).

null_result_and_retune_precommitment.subsequent_retune_rule: One-shot holdout evaluation. Any further hyperparameter, reward, or selection change after scoring EVAL_VIRGIN_V2 requires minting EVAL_VIRGIN_V3 with a fresh generator seed and disjoint slot pool.
